status: implemented-and-isolated-ui-verified; real switch on a live environment and new-terminal resolution not performed
implementation: switch_env now returns SwitchDiagnosis instead of unit, so a switch can be reported as done-but-ineffective
diagnose_switch reads the new current junction target and probes the environment version without executing the switched tool
each environment type maps to the commands a terminal would resolve (java/javac, python/pip, node/npm, go, rustc/cargo, mvn, gradle, php, clang, zig, deno, bun, git, gh, gcc, adb)
the expected entry directory is the first declared PATH entry that actually contains the launcher, falling back to the first declared entry
resolution reuses the read-only merged-PATH resolver already used by the package-manager preview, so both features share one rule
pathStatus distinguishes not-in-path, shadowed and requires-new-terminal; an empty registry read reports unknown
retained/notes explain that an already-open terminal keeps the old environment and that the diagnosis writes nothing
the environments page shows the resolved target, per-command status and a shadowed-command warning; a shadowed or missing command degrades the toast to 命令生效待确认 instead of plain success

uiCoverage.release-052-ui: switching an LLVM environment asserts the returned current target and 命令解析：clang 命中受管入口; a shadowed fixture asserts the degraded 命令生效待确认 toast and the 被靠前安装覆盖 marker

notVerified: No real environment was switched on this host; the diagnosis ran only through fixtures and a simulated UI backend
Version probing of a real junction target was not exercised
No new terminal was opened to confirm the reported resolution order
limitations: The diagnosis does not start the switched command; a launcher that exists but cannot run is still reported as managed
Shell aliases, cmd built-ins and Windows App Paths are not modelled
The version string comes from the existing probe, so an unparseable tool leaves version null without failing the switch
